lines.text: A coast with no lighthouse. Louie left this posting years ago. He never says why.

lines.speaker: Lampwick Louie
lines.text: Forty years I lit this water. Then one night the storm was faster than my wick. A mail ship went down. Every letter aboard... lost.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: The Dead Letter King released everything. Louie... some of those letters might have made it after all.

lines.speaker: Lampwick Louie
lines.text: ...then light me up, hero. One last shift. Let's go find out.
The storm clears. On the rocks: a mailbag, sea-worn but sealed. Postmarked the night the light went out.

lines.speaker: Lampwick Louie
lines.text: They wrote back. All those years... the ship's crew wrote back. "The light held long enough. We made the far shore. Thank you, keeper."

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: ...I'm not crying. It's sea spray. It's EMOTIONAL sea spray.

lines.speaker: Lampwick Louie
lines.text: Freelance rates apply from tomorrow. Tonight, the light's on the house.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Warm Rock Appreciation Day! The kingdom's first holiday ratified by unanimous vote, three abstentions (all pebbles, jealous).

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What are the festival activities?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Holding the rock. Appreciating the rock. There is also a raffle. The prize is proximity to the rock.
Monday retreats, defeated by a holiday it could not cancel. The crowd holds Warm Rock aloft. Warm Rock radiates quiet, perfect warmth.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Somewhere, Spooky Pebble is watching. Maybe next year, cousin. Maybe next year.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Welcome to Onboarding! Grab an orb, drag it anywhere — every orb you cross swaps places with it. You have ten seconds per move. Make them count!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Three of the same color in a line. Got it.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: And SEPARATE matches mean SEPARATE attacks! Two Fire matches? Your Fire heroes swing TWICE. It's in the handbook. I wrote the handbook.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Pink Heart orbs heal your party — match them when your HP dips. And when the board settles, new orbs fall. Chain those cascades for bonus combos!

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: See the number on the enemy? That's its countdown. Every move you finish ticks it down — at zero, it acts! Fire beats Nature, Nature beats Water, Water beats Fire. Light and Dark? They beat each OTHER.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: And skills charge from matching my element.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Look at you! Tap a glowing portrait when the skill is READY. Your leader's skill is always on — build your team around it!
